lines.text: A few days later in Eden...
Johan's mind is unsettled.
Since the battle with the Queen, there has not been a single day his heart has been at peace.
That painful defeat weighs heavily on him.
What happened afterward only made things more complicated.
The corruption of Nayuta's true body.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... This is devastating.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It'll be fine. Knowing her, she'll come out of this like it's nothing.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Then right on cue, she'll waltz in looking smug as ever.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: But you said she was corrupted...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Even that won't be a problem.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I believe in Nayuta.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I can't tell if that's trust or just blind optimism.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: She may not have always told us everything.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: But she's always been thinking several steps ahead, and we've benefited from that numerous times.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: So things will be all right. I trust her.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Fine.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Then I'll trust the monk too.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Come to think of it, there's no way someone as conniving as her would be struck down like a dog.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She must have something up her sleeve.
The Rapture strategist called Mirror.
The newborn Raptures the Queen is said to be creating.
New Heretics like Altruia and Egovista. There may even be more. There probably are.
Liberalio, who arrived in Eden with only her head remaining.
Rose, severely damaged, now unresponsive, with only her brainwaves still active.
An unidentified weapon dubbed Red Shoes.
So many new and unfamiliar things keep converging in Eden.
Johan is conservative by nature.
He is not accustomed to accepting things he doesn't have a full grasp on.
His years spent on the surface have only pushed that tendency to an even greater extreme.
*Squelch*
Johan steps on something.
He frowns and slowly lifts his foot.
A sticky black liquid stretches between his boot and the floor.
Johan's head hurts.
He is afraid to open the door before him,
but he can longer ignore the noise coming from outside.
After taking a short breath, Johan opens the door.
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hey! I told you not to eat every single thing you find!

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Sis gave me.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who?! Was it Ziz?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? N-no, it wasn't me...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Then who was it?!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I gave it to her. Was I not supposed to?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She refuses to eat her meals because she keeps snacking all the time.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Come on, kids should be able to eat what they want.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You can't go through life just doing whatever you want! Sometimes you have to do things you don't want to do!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wow, you're being all philosophical all of a sudden.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Hmm... this is certainly heavy.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: See? It's too heavy for you to lift, isn't it?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I said it was heavy. I didn't say I couldn't lift it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Hngh...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Wow! A pseudohuman like you could lift my pincers?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It's no big deal. It's your turn.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You want me to lift your weapon? I could do that with one hand.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hngh...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What the... How do you carry all of this around?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: With my strength, of course.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: The sub-arm distributes the weight. There's no way you could lift it with strength alone.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Huh. You little liar.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Even if the weight is distributed, I'm still lifting it with my own strength.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: A valid point. The total weight doesn't change simply because it's distributed.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Allow me, the ever astute Bahamut, to enlighten you. It's called the law of the totality of mass.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: There's no such law.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I was mistaken. Was it the law of weight conservation?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That's not a thing either.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Hmph! And what would you know about that to act so smug? Don't underestimate the brilliance of my intelligence!

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Pardon me, but what are you reading?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: A blank notebook. It used to be a book, but it became blank.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, in my infinite wisdom, absorbed all the knowledge in it, rendering it blank.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I've never heard of such a thing in my life.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wow! Check out her forehead, Cecil. It's so smooth.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hey! Don't touch my forehead!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Goodness, you could practically use it as a mirror.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Shiny.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hehehehe, it's blinding!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oww... my eyes!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-I mean... the sun is so blinding...!
The moment he opens the door, the troubling thoughts that had been swirling in Johan's mind vanish.
His brain mobilizes every resource at its disposal, in order to find a way to bring order to this chaotic situation.
He combs through his memory and speaks the words he once used to resolve situations like these.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Be quiet.
But things do not quieten down at all.
Johan's head pounds.
He needs to resolve this situation one way or another.
He quickly assesses what's happening.
He approaches the source of the commotion, the person whom everyone is shouting at.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wh-what is it?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Are you the leader?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You could say that... for the time being.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We need to sort some things out.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You call yourselves the Four Beast, correct?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You're Heretics.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Who created the Queen.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: And you're her associates.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... You saddle up to just about anyone, don't you?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I've been briefed about you ahead of time. Your...
Johan is startled by the sudden strange sensation against his leg.
He looks down.
A girl is clinging to his leg.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hug me.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: My my, just a kid and already taken with a handsome face.
Johan ignores the girl and continues.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: As I was saying, your...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hug me.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... end goal is? I have a hard time believing you helped us out of...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hug me.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... goodwill, so I need you to be clear about your intentions. You're aware of who we're going up against...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hug me.
Johan bends down and lifts the girl up.
He holds her out at arm's length and looks at her.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehe. Hug me.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... I don't know how I'm supposed to hug you.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Just wrap your arms snug around her!
Johan brings the girl into his embrace with stiff, awkward movements.
She falls asleep almost instantly.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... She's asleep.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're right. She'll sleep in just about anyone's arms.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Do I have to keep holding her like this?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes. If you put her down, there'll be hell to pay.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She'll cry and scream and all that.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... How long do I have to stay like this?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Umm... probably until she wakes up?
Johan looks down at the sleeping girl in her arms.
The thoughts that had been tormenting him moments ago are completely gone.
Focusing all his attention on holding the girl, Johan stood frozen in place.
This is the first time Cecil has seen this side of Johan.
She bursts out laughing in the end.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... All right. I have a clear picture of what's going on.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We'll cooperate.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Do I need to remind you who we're up against?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: There's no need. We've met her.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hmm... so that was the Queen. No wonder...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What would happen if we leave her alone?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I have no idea at all.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: According to Snow White, she's establishing a new faction.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Which means they intend to create a world of their own.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Any notion of coexistence is just a pipe dream.
Leviathan stares at the girl asleep in Johan's arms.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's reason enough.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We're in.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Good.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: So we just wait until the Young Man contacts us?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: For now, yes.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Understood. We'll wait then.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Isn't she heavy?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: No. I've gotten the hang of it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... I see.
The girl suddenly opens her eyes wide.
She slips out of Johan's arms and runs off.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: H-hey! Where are you going?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Honestly! I can't take my eyes off her for even a second.
Leviathan chases after the girl.
Johan rises and follows.
Without the slightest hesitation, the girl runs through Eden.
Something about her path she's taking strikes Johan as strange.
The place she is heading to is clearly...
*Whirr*
The girl quietly stares at Marian, lying there as if asleep.
She waves her hand in front of her face, but Marian does not wake.
She reaches out and places her hand on Marian's chest.
No heartbeat can be felt.
The girl takes a step back,
and places her hand on her own chest.
She feels two heartbeats.
The girl continues to stare at Marian.
